items.normalized_contribution: Limit the configured dedicated approval-model behavior to Personal Assistant / IM; keep Coding CLI behavior unchanged.
The shared kernel should support either explicitly selecting an approval-classification model or leaving that model unconfigured.

When no dedicated approval model is configured, preserve the existing per-triggering-Agent or run-model classification behavior; only an explicit configuration makes classification use one specified model.
Use the dedicated model only for automatic tool-permission classification; ordinary Agent requests and post-tool continuations must continue using the run model.

Once configured, the dedicated model must handle every automatic tool-permission classification across all PA runtime sources, including their subagents, while paths requiring no classification retain existing behavior.
An explicitly selected model absent from the PA model catalog is a Gateway startup configuration error and must never silently fall back.
